entries.prompt: Create one horizontal 16:10 desktop website HERO mockup for Axon Enjin, rendered edge to edge, crisp readable UI, no browser frame. Keep the text wordmark AXON ENJIN and small cyan point, do not invent a logo. This is a restructuring within the existing brand, not a rebrand; do not copy the reference's card-grid composition. Visitor needs to immediately understand the Operating Layer for multi-branch businesses. A quiet single-row nav: wordmark, Product, Modules, Company, and blue pill Talk to us. Short intro label 'Software for multi-branch businesses'. Headline 'ONE SYSTEM FOR EVERY BRANCH.' Clear supporting text 'Bring your people, stock, and reports into one place. Add the tools you need.' Primary 'See modules', secondary 'Talk to us'. Composition leads with confident typography and a useful visual: on the right, a restrained cyan point-and-line network with a central Head office and three Branch nodes, its bottom connections aligning into a small dark Operating Layer product preview. This depicts the start of a network-to-dashboard scroll morph. Maintain generous space, ordinary readable copy, no cosmic fog, no starfield, no explosive sphere, no loading screen, no fake customers or metrics. Small 'Illustrative product view' caption. Only one hero section.
